title: Childhood visits from little gray beings

tellings.quote: with the little gray guys in my room

plain: John Blitch, described on a podcast as a scientist for DARPA (the Pentagon's agency for advanced research), says that as a boy growing up in Peabody, Massachusetts, in the 1960s and 70s, he had visits from small gray beings. He talks about being "with the little gray guys in my room". He tells it as part of a wider account of being taken by aliens, which, if true, would mean non-human beings visited a child who later worked in government science.
